scenario.summary: A Mallox ransomware affiliate gained access to internet-facing MS-SQL servers by brute-forcing the 'sa' account. Once inside, they leveraged SQL features like xp_cmdshell and CLR assemblies to stage a PowerShell script that deployed the PureCrypter loader, which ultimately executed the Mallox ransomware payload while attempting to evade detection through sandbox checks and security tool patching.

hunt.name: Mallox Ransomware Impact and File Encryption
hunt.description: This hunt isolates the final impact stage of the Mallox ransomware lifecycle. It identifies processes running from non-standard, user-writable directories (such as AppData or ProgramData) and correlates them with anomalous file system activity. By stacking rare process paths and monitoring for bursts of file creation, updates, or renames, we can isolate encryption behavior even as specific filenames rotate. The hunt identifies processes that demonstrate both high volume (mass encryption) and low prevalence (unique payload).

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/appdata/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\programdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/programdata/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify any processes launched from %AppData% or %ProgramData%, which are common staging areas for the Mallox payload.
config.expected_signal: Hosts running binaries from user-writable paths. While common for updaters, this provides the base scope for impact correlation.

primitive_config.label: Process execution from writable directories
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/appdata/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\programdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/programdata/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Hosts running binaries from user-writable paths. While common for updaters, this provides the base scope for impact correlation.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/appdata/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\programdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/programdata/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count processes in writable paths to identify unique or low-prevalence payloads like Mallox.
config.expected_signal: A binary appearing on very few hosts. Legitimate software (Teams, Chrome) will show high host counts.

primitive_config.label: Rare binaries in writable paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/appdata/%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\programdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/programdata/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_path) HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A binary appearing on very few hosts. Legitimate software (Teams, Chrome) will show high host counts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, activity_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count, MIN(time) AS start_window, MAX(time) AS end_window FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\appdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/appdata/%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\programdata\\%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/programdata/%') AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, activity_name HAVING event_count > {{encryption_threshold}} ORDER BY event_count DESC
config.description: Find processes in writable paths that are performing high volumes of Create, Update, or Rename events, signaling active encryption.
config.expected_signal: A process from a writable path touching hundreds of files. This narrows the high-volume file surface by path and volume simultaneously.
